title: Boundary Wall Throw Detection
tagline: Catches goods being thrown over the wall, on camera.

meta.title: Boundary Wall Throw Detection | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Catches goods being thrown over the wall, on camera.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Materials thrown over factory or warehouse boundary walls are a real theft vector, and continuous human surveillance across a long perimeter isn't practical.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: AI models analyze movement and trajectory patterns to recognize a throw event specifically, then trigger an alarm and save video evidence instantly.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Perimeter security that doesn't depend on someone watching a monitor continuously.
